name: Net Defender Demo
summary: Net Defender is a VR game that lets you experience the thrill of being a goalkeeper in a futuristic football match. You have to use your hands to block the shots from the opposing team, which come at you at different speeds and angles. The game tracks your movements and scores you based on how many shots you save and how many you let in.
